title: Dimension-free boundary-ray interpolation and spectral stitching
statement: For every singular correlation C and A_mu=mu I+(1-mu)C, the inverse moment satisfies K(A_mu)>=(1+mu)^{-2}K(C). A full shorted boundary certificate K(C)>=kappa P_tau combines with the exact J_2 spectral bound to give K(A_mu)>=[b r_tau/(b+r_tau)]mu A_mu^{-1}, with b=kappa/(1+mu)^2 and the documented empty-high-block convention.
assumptions: The stitching conclusion assumes a full Loewner shorted boundary certificate, not only its compression
When the high spectral block is empty, r_tau is interpreted as infinity
open_objections: The boundary low-spectral-layer shorting certificate is still open.
Endpoint-only stitching provably loses the mesoscale signed-rank-one regime.
No priority audit, formalization, or external-human validation exists.
